Many recipes — both sweet and savory — will call for lime zest when a dish just needs that extra zing. Grated lime zest is commonly used in baking, sauces, marinades, and salad dressings. Larger zest pieces work well for garnish on cakes, pies, and most famously on cocktails like a classic lime drop martini.
Lime zest comes from the peel of a lime, but it does not include the inner layer of the peel known as the albedo. This inner layer contains the "pith," or the soft, white, substance that has a naturally bitter taste.
Zest is most commonly grated, but so long as you're only removing the outermost layer of the peel, you can also use zest in large pieces, thin strips, or even curled pieces for garnish.

Many recipes — both sweet and savory — will call for Orange zest when a dish just needs that extra zing. Grated Orange zest is commonly used in baking, sauces, marinades, and salad dressings. Larger zest pieces work well for garnish on cakes, pies, and most famously on cocktails like a classic Orange drop martini.
Orange zest comes from the peel of a Orange, but it does not include the inner layer of the peel known as the albedo. This inner layer contains the "pith," or the soft, white, substance that has a naturally bitter taste.
Zest is most commonly grated, but so long as you're only removing the outermost layer of the peel, you can also use zest in large pieces, thin strips, or even curled pieces for garnish.

Merlot Product Overview
Merlot is a 100% natural red grape juice concentrate crafted from healthy, hand-selected grapes. This viscous red liquid is free from any added flavorings, colorings, or preservatives, offering an authentic, unfermented grape juice experience. Using advanced evaporator technology, the water is carefully removed to maintain the product's pure concentration, making it ideal for use in a wide range of food and beverage products.
Quality and Composition
Merlot concentrate boasts a Brix level of 67-69 at 20°C and a total acidity of 1.0-2.1% tartaric acid by weight. Its pH level ranges from 2.8 to 3.8, and the color intensity is measured between 400-800 at 520 nm, delivering a rich and vibrant hue. With turbidity kept under 150 NTU at 16º Brix and total sulfur dioxide content below 50 mg/kg, Merlot meets stringent quality standards for purity and safety.
Microbial Safety and Purity
Merlot undergoes comprehensive microbiological testing to ensure the highest level of safety and quality. Yeast, mold, and total plate counts (TPC) are all maintained at less than 10 UFC/g, while the product is free from coliform bacteria and thermo acidophilic bacteria (TAB). These rigorous controls ensure that Merlot is a safe, stable, and premium product suitable for high-quality food and beverage formulations.

Many recipes — both sweet and savory — will call for lime zest when a dish just needs that extra zing. Grated lime zest is commonly used in baking, sauces, marinades, and salad dressings. Larger zest pieces work well for garnish on cakes, pies, and most famously on cocktails like a classic lime drop martini.
Lime zest comes from the peel of a lime, but it does not include the inner layer of the peel known as the albedo. This inner layer contains the "pith," or the soft, white, substance that has a naturally bitter taste.
Zest is most commonly grated, but so long as you're only removing the outermost layer of the peel, you can also use zest in large pieces, thin strips, or even curled pieces for garnish.
Processing
Limes are harvested by hand and delivered fresh to the factory, each load is quality assurance sampled for foreign material and physical defects. The lemon peel is washed, milled, inspected and frozen to -18°C or below.
Packing
During packing the lime zest are inspected before weighing and filling into lined cartons. The cartons are check weighed, palletised and stretch-wrapped before being returned to store at -23°C to await despatch, at -18°C.

This tropical fruit can have a 80% of water, turning to be an hypochaloric food. The pineapple contains an enzyme called bromelain which helps our body to improve the intake of proteins.
The pineapples offers organic acids, common in certain citric fruit. The malic acid and citric are present. The first help in the harnessing of energy from the food, while the citric is an antioxidant.
VITAMIN C IS THE MOST ABUNDANT IN THE PINEAPPLE

The pineapple is rich in potassium, mineral which eases the flow of nutrients into the cells. It also has other minerals as the iron, which takes part in the oxygen transmission through blood, or the magnesium.
Fibre has a wide presence in the pineapple, sharing certain laxating feature and being a great intestinal regulator. The pineapple, moreover, reduces the levels of cholesterol in blood thanks to the things mentioned before. For this, it is ideal to be consumed entire or, for example, in pineapple juice.
Apart from the pineapple, there are many fruit characterized by its diuretic power. Among them, we can mention the orange, the melon or the watermelon, all of them with a high water volume.
The pineapple is a sour fruit which can be consumed in juices, concentrates or purees.

The pink guava is a tropical fruit, of exotic appearance and multiple benefits for the body. It is mainly different from the white guava in the colour of its flesh which is reddish to dark pink. Moreover, its flavour keeps similarities with other fruits as the strawberry.
One of the main benefits which the pink guava offers is its high volume in vitamin C, an important substance needed for several tasks of the human body. Its consumption, therefore, is daily recommended.
Its firm and juicy pulp contains a great powerful aroma, and that, together with its delicate and exotic colour make this fruit highly appealing for the senses.
THE PINK GUAVA HAS ASTRINGENT PROPERTIES

Among its different properties, the pink guava contains anthelmintic substances which are useful to combat intruders in our body, as it may be the appearance of fungus or parasites.
It also contains important quantities of carotene, natural pigment which arouses its reddish hues. These help to prevent, among other things, degenerative and cardiovascular diseases.
The pink guava is a little exotic fruit, perfect for the preparation of concentrates and purees.

The mango fruit is an exotic food very appreciated in cooking due to all its different possibilities. We are talking about a juicy and refreshing fruit ideal for having in summer in the shape of mango fruit concentrate, among other possibilities.
This tropical fruit provides us with great quantities of vitamin C and pro vitamin A, being an important booster of our immune system. Moreover, the mango fruit has many carbohydrates, so it is perfect for athletes.
It contains water in a high percentage of its weight. In fact, in some cases, the mango fruit water reaches to complete the total volume of its weight (75%-80%) Because of this it is considered to be very refreshing and moisturizing.

Among the minerals complementing the mango fruit, we find a remarkable quantity of potassium and magnesium. The first one is very useful to erase the wastes of cells, while the other helps attaching the calcium in bones.
The mango fruit has a satiating power and, due to its fibre, is a natural laxative, being advisable in weight-loss diets. Other fruit with a high fibre volume are the tangerine, raspberry and the pineapple.
At Valencia Orange we have the varieties of mango totapuri, alphonso, kent, magdalena river and tommy. The mango fruit can be consumed in concentrates and purees.

The white guava is tropical fruit full of beneficial properties for the body. Of striking appearance, with shades ranging from green to yellow, it hides inside a white colour flesh which contains seeds.
Among its benefits we can start mentioning its generous volume of vitamins from the type B, which are highly necessary for our body as they ease the intake of proteins, fats and carbohydrates.
The white guava contains important quantities of folic acid, included in the type B vitamin substances which favours the proper functioning of blood.
THE WHITE GUAVA HAS ANTISEPTIC PROPERTIES

We can find another benefit in its astringent properties, perfect for people with gastrointestinal conditions, as it may be the diarrhoea. It is a fruit with a high cleanser power, indicated on different diets.
Apart from the numerous benefits it offers, the white guava is also a remarkably aromatic fruit whose scent can remind of citrus fruits as the lemon.
The white guava is a tropical fruit perfect for the elaboration of concentrates and purees.

The tamarind is a peculiar fruit in the shape of a hard shell pod. Brown coloured, inside the hard pod it hides some seeds of great sweetness and spicy flavour at the same time. These little seeds, apart from their original flavour combination, have many things to offer to our body.
To begin with, we must focus on its delivery of nutrients as the carbohydrates, proteins and fats. Such a substance combination makes the tamarind the perfect food for sportsmen and people with certainly demanding routines.
In the field of minerals, the tamarind contains a long list of them, starting with the calcium needed for the bone formation. Potassium is widely present in this fruit, being once again a recommended substance for sportsmen.
THE TAMARIND CONTAINS IRON AND MAGNESIUM

As far as the vitamins offered by the tamarind, we must begin talking about the type B vitamins. This wide vitamin group is in charge of several body functions, hence its daily importance.
The other great vitamin contained in the tamarind is the vitamin C, of mandatory use if we want our body to have a full performance and in the best possible way.
The tamarind is the ideal fruit to the elaboration of concentrates and purees. Furthermore in Valencia Orange we also have organic tamarind.

The banana is a tropical fruit highly consumed by athletes and people with a certain phsical activity, but its qualities go beyond that. We are in front of a fruit with neither fat nor cholesterol.
The welth in vitamins of the banana starts with the plentiful vitamin A, which contributes to the bones and soft tissues keeping; type B vitamins provide energy to the body; and vitamin C, which combined with the previous ones, protects and improves the immune system.
The banana is the perfect food to be introduced in babies first meals as banana puree, but also is good in different shapes as the banana concentrate.

The banana contains big quantites of potassium, about 15% of the adult daily intake. This way, it contributes effectively to fight arterial hypertension.
Moreover, the banana delivers magnessium into our daily diet, essential mineral to preserve the muscles and the nervous system or producing energy and protein.
The sportmen consumer is one of the most demanding in relation with the quantity of energy a fruit can offer, due to this, apart from the banana is advisable to have strawberries, cranberry or even passion fruit for a change.
The banana is a food which can be consumed in concentrates and purees.

Coconut is a very refreshing and hydrating tropical fruit thanks to the juice it keeps inside. It has great nutritional properties and offers several benefits applicable to different areas, both nutritional and cosmetic.
The large amount of water is the main characteristic of coconut, but it also has a high fiber content, which gives it laxative effects. In addition, it promotes its use in the diets of people who need to lower their cholesterol.
Vitamin E is the most important of those contained in coconut, providing its antioxidant capacities. It also contains vitamin C, and to a lesser extent type B1 and B2 vitamins. It must be taken into account, as we will see later, that it has a great caloric power.
COCONUT IS A NATURAL SOURCE OF FIBER

Due to the calories coconut contains and its amounts of water, it is an ideal fruit for making energy drinks, juices and sports preparations or energy waters. In this way, minerals such as potassium or sodium can be used. For all these reasons, coconut is the perfect ally to combine with other fruits in juices or drinks.
Cosmetic opportunities are also part of the properties of the coconut, which has become one of the most used fruits to make moisturizers, oils, purifying waters and hair solutions.
Coconut is a tropical fruit available in Valencia Orange, diced, coconut cream and coconut water.

Apples are useful to control cholesterol. It is recommended the daily intake of apple in great quantities for people who suffer high cholesterol, this is why its consumption in apple juice or apple puree is a great way to vary.

It has certain elements with alcaline properties in its structure. These contribute to the right performing of some liver tasks, acting in some organic processes of the body.
Vitamin C and betacarotenes or vitamin A are really present, serving as a reinforcement for creating a powerfull immune system, resilient to possible issues in our body.

In the red grape can be found different antioxidants, in which the resveratrol is highlighted, this substance aids in the reduction of inflammation in many body parts and also, a reduction of cholesterol, among other things.

In short, the red grape can be compared because of certain structural elements or nutrients to the white grape and the pomegranate.

In hypocaloric and weight-loss diets is advisable, due to its high water and fibre levels. This defines the pear as a juicy food as well as diuretic, also, it is beneficial for the intestinal transit.
Ideal to be taken as cold apple juice due to its refreshing value, or in a nutritious apple puree, it has much versatility on its consumption. In spite of this, its properties are not in danger because of that. The digestion ease is one of its strong points.

Despite being sweet (it contains glucose and fructose), the apricot has a low sugar and carbohydrate levels, offering little calories by its consumption. Due to this, it is an ideal fruit for tasting in a refreshing apricot juice.

Among the most abundants minerals in the apricot, we can find the iron.
Because of this, it is highly recommended in people who suffer from anemia and need a diet rich in this mineral.
One of the qualities which collaborates the most with our well-being is the anti-inflammatory power given by the tannins, which help to reduce the intestine. In a similar sphere, we can find fruit like the pomegranate and the persimmon.
The apricot is a fruit to be consumed in juices, purees or concentrates.

In the side of vitamins, the white grape adds different vitamins from the type B, besides vitamin A and C, responsible for the good sight health, the immune system and the proper skin condition, among other things.
The white grape provides our body with tannins, helping, for example, to trap our body the free radicals and performing as an antioxidant. We can benefit from these features even in a fresh grape juice.

We can find in the white grape minerals from the common potassium and phosphorus to magnesium, element which contributes to the keep of the muscle tissue.

Because of its look, the peach is similar, either by colour or texture, to other fruit as the persimmon or the apricot. It even shares certain nutrients as the carotenes.

The persimmon’s fibre comes mainly from the pectin and the mucilages. These soluble fibres promote regularity in our body intestinal transit, specially, when the persimmon is ripe.

The persimmon is rich in vitamin C, essential element in the improvement and strenghtening of our immune system; also in betacarotene or provitamine A, giving the persimmon antioxidant properties.
It is specially recommended for taking care of the sight due to its volume in zeaxanthin, carotenoid which protects the sight. Because of this, it has a certain similarity to the peach or the apricot.
The persimmon is a sweet fruit that can be consumed in juices, concentrates or purees.

The watermelon is a sweet fruit which inevitably, because of its freshness and taste, reminds us to the summer. Rich in vitamin C and vitamin A, the watermelon is good to our body in many different ways.
The vitamin A is an important source of beta-carotene, helping to protect the sight and the skin; on the other hand, the vitamin is beneficial to reinforce our immune system, among other things.
In the watermelon, the beta-carotene it is strenghten by the action of lycopene. This combination turns the watermelon into a very healthy food, which linked to vitamin c, helps to prevent cardiovascular diseases and possible cancerous conditions.

Thanks to this high water volume, the watermelon has a diuretic effect and helps to remove unnecessary substances from our body. Furthermore, It is a versatile fruit to be eaten, both in juices or purees, as well as seasoning dishes.
The watermelon has high levels of potassium, a mineral which adds control to the blood pressure and helps to improve the cardiovascular system. Something similar to what is offered by the banana and the pear.
The watermelon is a high healthy food that can be consumed in juices, concentrates or purees.
